analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions maintained a wait-and-see approach. RSI at 50.9 has exited oversold but continues to consolidate in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows continued improvement but remains in negative territory. A Higher Low pattern is confirmed with the 5-day low at 34,485 KRW and the 20-day low at 25,055 KRW. Volume ratio at 0.88 is at a normal level. Weekly ADX at 41.2 confirms a clear trend, but daily directionality is absent. The current price of 35,990 KRW is trading within the swing resistance of 36,570 KRW and swing support of 34,485 KRW range.
